sponsored.t: Improves affordability and the recruitment and retention of volunteer firefighters and volunteer ambulance workers through local tax incentives
sponsored.sum: Increases the tax exemption on real property owned by members of volunteer fire companies or voluntary ambulance services in certain counties.

sponsored.t: Protects minors online from addictive features of social media
sponsored.sum: Protects minors online from addictive features of social media; establishes penalties for failing to restrict certain minors from certain features.

sponsored.t: Requires all school districts to screen all students for dyslexia and dysgraphia
sponsored.sum: Requires all school districts to screen all students for dyslexia and dysgraphia; requires school districts to provide notice of such screening to each student and to the parent or guardian of each student; allows parents and guardians to opt out.

sponsored.t: Requires government entities review and post information about funds received pursuant to the statewide opioid settlement agreement
sponsored.sum: Requires government entities review and post information about funds received pursuant to the statewide opioid settlement agreement including information about how such funds are being used properly.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of Schenectady to discontinue the use as parkland and transfer control of the Woodlawn Preserve; relates to the membership of the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of Schenectady, county of Schenectady, to discontinue the use as parkland and transfer the lands known as the Woodlawn Preserve to the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission to be made part of the Albany Pine Bush preserve and to be under the control of the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission; adds the mayor of Schenectady to the Albany Pine Bush preserve commission.

sponsored.t: Prohibits unlawful seizure of ballots
sponsored.sum: Prohibits unlawful seizure of ballots; provides that a violation is a class E felony.

sponsored.t: Establishes statewide substance abuse prevention and intervention services for all grade levels
sponsored.sum: Establishes statewide substance abuse prevention and intervention services for all grade levels; requires a tax on digital asset transactions to fund statewide substance abuse prevention and intervention services.

sponsored.t: Requires contractors with the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services maintain an operating reserve
sponsored.sum: Requires contractors with the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services maintain an operating reserve to be used to address financial issues that occur during a contract year.

sponsored.t: Relates to decreasing the electronic death registration system fee for funeral directors and undertakers
sponsored.sum: Relates to decreasing the electronic death registration system fee for funeral directors and undertakers from twenty to five dollars.

sponsored.t: Establishes the fentanyl and xylazine test strip program
sponsored.sum: Provides free fentanyl test strips to individuals at specified distribution facilities; requires a public awareness campaign on the dangers of fentanyl and the provision of the test strips.

sponsored.t: Relates to the number of members in the public service commission
sponsored.sum: Increases the number of members in the public service commission from five to seven members.

sponsored.t: Requires a certain type of opioid overdose rescue kit be provided by the state to schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the state to provide a certain type of opioid and fentanyl rescue kit to schools.

sponsored.t: Replaces the word addict or addicts and the word addiction with the words persons with substance use disorder or a variation thereof
sponsored.sum: Replaces certain appearances of the words addict, addicts and addiction with the words person with a substance use disorder, person with a mental health disorder, person with co-occurring disorder, person in recovery, or a variation thereof.

sponsored.t: Requires certain covered platforms to provide a process for law enforcement agencies to contact such platform, and to comply with search warrants within seventy-two hours
sponsored.sum: Requires an operator of a covered platform with at least one million users to ensure that its covered platform provides a process to allow law enforcement agencies to contact such covered platform, which shall provide continuous availability of such process; provides that an operator of a covered platform with at least one million users shall comply with a search warrant within seventy-two hours of receipt under certain circumstances; provides that a court may extend the time for compliance with a search warrant under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Establishes a medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants test strip program
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services to establish a program for individuals to receive free drug test strips to detect the presence of medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants; directs the commissioner of the office of alcoholism and substance abuse services, in cooperation with the commissioner of the department of health, to develop and conduct a public awareness and educational campaign on the dangers of medetomidine, benzodiazepine, nitazenes, and/or other harmful contaminants.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of 7-hydroxymitragynine products
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of products that contain 7-hydroxymitragynine at a level that exceeds 2% of total alkaloids or one milligram per serving; establishes fines for the sale of such products.

sponsored.t: Relates to preventing minors from participating in sports wagering
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to preventing minors from participating in sports wagering and creating accounts on mobile sports wagering platforms; requires platforms to employ commercially reasonable and technically feasible age assurance methods.

sponsored.t: Provides for elder abuse prevention training
sponsored.sum: Requires the office for the aging to develop and provide elder abuse prevention training to train senior service centers and entities that contract with the office for the aging and the office of children and family services to provide services to elderly persons in the detection and reporting of elder abuse in consultation with the office of children and family services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the application of New York state's human rights law to out-of-state employees
sponsored.sum: Relates to the application of New York state's human rights law to employees who work outside of the state of New York, if their employer maintains a physical address within New York state.

sponsored.t: Authorizes all municipalities to join a county self-funded or self-insured health plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes all municipalities, with the consent of the county and the governing body of such municipality, to join a county self-funded or self-insured health plan; requires certification.

sponsored.t: Requires mental health evaluations for participants in substance use disorder treatment programs
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of the office of addiction services and supports to require mental health evaluations for participants in substance use disorder treatment programs and to promulgate rules and regulations to effectuate such requirement.

sponsored.t: Enacts the individual counseling rate enhancement act
sponsored.sum: Requires a rate enhancement for reimbursement of individual psychotherapy services provided by a mental health counselor, a clinical social worker, or a psychologist where such services are provided in an outpatient substance use disorder clinic.

sponsored.t: Relates to the distribution of educational materials regarding the misuse of and addiction to prescription drugs in counties with the most prevalent prescription substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Relates to the distribution of educational materials regarding the misuse of and addiction to prescription drugs in counties with the most prevalent prescription substance use disorder.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "recovery ready workplace act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "recovery ready workplace act" which provides for the certification of an employer to become a recovery ready workplace.

sponsored.t: Relates to interest earned on the statewide opioid settlement agreement money
sponsored.sum: Includes interest earned on the monies obtained by the state through the statewide opioid settlement agreement, in the opioid settlement fund; requires any New York subdivision that receives funds pursuant to an opioid settlement agreement to spend interest earned on such funds on approved uses.

sponsored.t: Relates to the construction of facilities for chemical dependence services that promote the privacy of individuals
sponsored.sum: Relates to the construction of facilities for chemical dependence services that promote the privacy of individuals while bathing, sleeping, using restrooms and receiving individual counseling services, while also allowing for maximization of the use of such facility.

sponsored.t: Relates to the optional retirement of members employed as an emergency medical technician, critical care technician, advanced emergency medical technician, paramedic or supervisor
sponsored.sum: Provides as an alternative retirement option from the current option, that any member employed as an emergency medical technician, critical care technician, advanced emergency medical technician, paramedic or supervisor of such titles upon an election by a participating fire district, not including those in a city with a population of one million or more, shall be eligible to retire.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment and responsibilities of the commissioners of the public service commission
sponsored.sum: Relates to the appointment and responsibilities of the commissioners of the public service commission; requires the commission to have a duty to protect public interest, including ensuring access to utility services for residential and business customers; prohibits commissioners from having been employed within the last two years by an electric, gas, steam, telecommunications, or water utility that is regulated by the commission.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Ryan J. St. Gelais and Aaron M. St. Gelais, police officers in the village of Menands, county of Albany, to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Ryan J. St. Gelais and Aaron M. St. Gelais, police officers in the village of Menands, county of Albany, to receive certain credit under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law and to apply for reinstatement with the NY state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Reforms the opioid settlement board to provide services and supports to grieving families
sponsored.sum: Reforms the opioid settlement board to provide services and supports to grieving families and include board members who lost a child, sibling, parent or close family member to substance use disorder.

sponsored.t: Relates to implementing a dangerous dog owner alert system
sponsored.sum: Relates to implementing a dangerous dog owner alert system.

sponsored.t: Relates to reporting allegations of child abuse or maltreatment that occurred to a resident of New York in another state
sponsored.sum: Relates to reporting allegations of child abuse or maltreatment that occurred to a resident of New York in another state to an agency having similar powers in the state in which the allegations occurred.

sponsored.t: Requires regulations fixing tuition rates for students once matriculated in a two or four-year program at any state-operated institution of the state university
sponsored.sum: Requires regulations fixing tuition rates for students once matriculated in a two or four-year program at any state-operated institution of the state university.

sponsored.t: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators from being eligible to receive the excelsior jobs program credit
sponsored.sum: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators, including parent companies or subsidiaries thereof, from being eligible to receive the excelsior jobs program credit.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for non-medical transportation for individuals with a substance use disorder to receive peer support services
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for non-medical transportation for individuals with a substance use disorder to receive peer support services.

sponsored.t: Creates the medical professionals across rural New York state student loan repayment fund pilot program
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the medical professionals across rural New York state student loan repayment fund pilot program for certain participating professionals that make a two year commitment to practice in a tract or county defined by the health resources and services administration as being rural or eligible for a rural health grant.

sponsored.t: Relates to anti-concurrent causation clauses
sponsored.sum: Provides that when a flood event not covered under a policy or specifically excluded is a contributing factor in or occurs simultaneously as a covered event or peril, the insurer shall not deny or exclude coverage for the loss or damage caused by the covered event or peril.

sponsored.t: Prohibits adverse employment action where an employee renders first aid or emergency treatment
sponsored.sum: Prohibits adverse employment action where an employee renders first aid or emergency treatment unless it is established that such employee was grossly negligent in providing such first aid or emergency treatment.

sponsored.t: Requires principals convicted of certain animal cruelty offenses undergo a presentencing forensic psychological evaluation and a report be submitted to the court based on such evaluation and to attend treatment
sponsored.sum: Requires principals convicted of certain animal cruelty offenses undergo a presentencing forensic psychological evaluation and a report be submitted to the court based on such evaluation and to attend counseling, humane education, a rehabilitation program, or other such treatment based on such report.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "protecting our kids from gamification of gambling act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "protecting our kids from gamification of gambling act"; makes it unlawful for operators of social gaming platforms to provide a service to a minor user that allows online gaming-related gambling.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "no gambling ads for kids act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "no gambling ads for kids act" under which certain covered platforms and social media platforms are prohibited from advertising a service permitting gaming-related gambling, predictive market wagering, online sweepstakes gaming, sports-related gambling, and/or traditional online gambling to minors.

sponsored.t: Requires insurance coverage of outpatient problem gambling services
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance companies to cover outpatient problem gambling services.

sponsored.t: Requires the superintendent of financial services to audit certain reports to ensure such insurers are in full compliance with federal and state mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements
sponsored.sum: Requires the superintendent of financial services to audit certain reports to ensure such insurers are in full compliance with federal and state mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements.

sponsored.t: Requires the electronic cigarette and vaping prevention, awareness and control program be used by all schools
sponsored.sum: Requires the electronic cigarette and vaping prevention, awareness and control program be used by all schools.

sponsored.t: Requires the state comptroller and the attorney general to conduct an annual audit of the office of cannabis management
sponsored.sum: Requires the state comptroller, the attorney general and independent certified public accountants to conduct an annual audit of the office of cannabis management.

sponsored.t: Relates to unlawful discriminatory practices under the state's human rights law
sponsored.sum: Relates to motivating factors behind unlawful discriminatory practices in employment practices; clarifies the reasonable accommodation process under the state's human rights law.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the public display of kratom advertisements
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the public display of kratom advertisements within a certain distance of schools.

sponsored.t: Prohibits sports wagering on school property
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits sports wagering on public elementary or secondary school property, or in or on a school bus.

sponsored.t: Requires certain kratom products to include a warning label
sponsored.sum: Requires certain kratom products to include a warning label with disclosures including, but not limited to, that kratom may be addictive and to keep it out of reach of children.

sponsored.t: Relates to the prohibition of the use of employment promissory notes and other similar provisions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the prohibition of the use of employment promissory notes and other similar provisions; defines transferable credential; relates to the effectiveness of such provisions.

sponsored.t: Relates to regulatory penalties, fines, and/or revocation for small business
sponsored.sum: Relates to regulatory penalties, fines, and/or revocation for small business.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of an online standardized medical physical examination form
sponsored.sum: Requires the health commissioner to establish an online standardized medical physical examination form.

sponsored.t: Relates to dispensing certain individuals with opioid reversal drugs upon discharge
sponsored.sum: Requires inpatient facilities to dispense at-risk individuals with opioid reversal drugs upon discharge.

sponsored.t: Requires the report on statewide opioid settlements include the amount of funds that have been spent
sponsored.sum: Requires the report on statewide opioid settlements include the amount of funds that have been spent and requires the public be provided information on how much funds have been spent.

sponsored.t: Provides a cost-of-living adjustment for members of retirement systems
sponsored.sum: Provides a cost-of-living adjustment for members of retirement systems by increasing the base benefit amount for computation to $21,000.

sponsored.t: Creates the fundamental right of the people to have access to public information
sponsored.sum: Creates the fundamental right of the people to have access to public information and to be provided notice of and to attend public meetings.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring the governor submit to oral questions from the legislature annually
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring the governor submit in person to oral questions from the legislature for two hours on an annual basis.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the governor from granting themselves or any person involved with furthering the illegal conduct of the governor a reprieve, commutation or pardon
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the governor from granting themselves or any person involved with furthering the illegal conduct of the governor a reprieve, commutation or pardon.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a procedure for the governor's annual message to the legislature regarding the state of the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a procedure for the governor's annual message to the legislature regarding the state of the state.

sponsored.t: Eliminates the withholding of state aid as an enforcement mechanism for court facility compliance, and establishes an appeal process for proposed court facility plans; repealer
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the withholding of state aid as an enforcement mechanism for court facility compliance; establishes an appeal process for proposed court facility plans; establishes a court facilities review panel to review the scope, reasonableness, feasibility, and proportionality of such plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to school districts unable to meet standards for zero-emissions school buses, due to market availability or supporting infrastructure
sponsored.sum: Provides additional exemptions to school districts unable to meet standards for zero-emissions school buses, due to market availability or supporting infrastructure.

sponsored.t: Requires the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property
sponsored.sum: Requires the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property when covenants, conditions and restrictions exist which discriminate on the basis of a protected class in violation of state or federal law.

sponsored.t: Restricts the use of prediction markets and/or mobile sports wagering platforms by certain public officers when using information acquired by such person in the course of their official duties
sponsored.sum: Restricts the use of prediction markets and/or mobile sports wagering platforms by officers or employees of a state agency, members of the legislature or legislative employees when using information acquired by such public officer in the course of their official duties.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Javier-Luis I. Martinez
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive tier II membership in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system to Javier-Luis I. Martinez, a current member of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system employed by the town of Colonie.

sponsored.t: Requires telecommunications system contracts provide for emergency 911
sponsored.sum: Requires telecommunications system contracts provide for emergency 911 in municipal land lease agreements.

sponsored.t: Prohibits certain entities from engaging in the business of securing motor vehicle registrations or giving instructions as to procuring motor vehicle registrations
sponsored.sum: Prohibits certain entities from engaging in the business of assisting for hire in securing motor vehicle registrations or, for compensation, giving instructions as to procuring motor vehicle registrations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the location of the principal office of the cannabis control board and office of cannabis management
sponsored.sum: Provides that the principal office of the cannabis control board and office of cannabis management shall be located in Albany county.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to create a prescription drug inventory database
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to create a prescription drug inventory database that contains a list of all drugs designated as being currently in shortage by the federal food and drug administration's drug shortages database, and a list of pharmacies in the state where each such drug is currently in stock.

sponsored.t: Relates to special day schools and the instruction of school delinquents
sponsored.sum: Provides that schools need not provide special instruction to delinquent students whose violent behavior poses an unreasonable risk to teachers and students in special day schools or special school rooms; permits shared services in connection with the establishment of such special schools.

sponsored.t: Relates to ensuring net metering is a compensation floor for residential producers of energy
sponsored.sum: Relates to ensuring net metering is a compensation floor for residential producers of energy.

sponsored.t: Establishes a one hundred percent clean renewable energy system for electricity by two thousand thirty
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a one hundred percent clean renewable energy system for electricity by two thousand thirty-four; provides such energy system shall include solar, wind, geothermal and tidal sources.

sponsored.t: Relates to pre-arranged for-hire vehicle transportation services and universal design and accessibility
sponsored.sum: Relates to pre-arranged for-hire vehicle transportation services and the maximization of universal design and accessibility by persons with disabilities.

sponsored.t: Establishes civil liability for anyone subjecting another person to the deprivation of any rights, privileges or immunities secured by law
sponsored.sum: Establishes civil liability for anyone subjecting another person to the deprivation of any rights, privileges or immunities secured by law; establishes that the supreme court shall have jurisdiction over such matters and that the prevailing party shall be awarded reasonable attorney's fees as part of the costs; provides that the state waives sovereign immunity for violations of such law.

sponsored.t: Relates to electronic notification when prior authorization is required to fill a prescription
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to provide electronic notification when prior authorization is required to fill a prescription if requested by the insured.

sponsored.t: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to William Kerr
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to William Kerr.

sponsored.t: Relates to retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Philip Apruzzese
sponsored.sum: Grants retroactive membership with Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system to Philip Apruzzese.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability of opioid reversal agents
sponsored.sum: Relates to the availability of opioid reversal agents; requires the department of health to make available any formulation and dosage of opioid reversal agent approved by the federal food and drug administration.

sponsored.t: Requires quarterly reporting on the amounts awarded and received from the opioid stewardship fund
sponsored.sum: Requires quarterly reporting on the opioid stewardship fund, including the names of the recipients and the amounts awarded and received.

sponsored.t: Permits only one traffic infraction per traffic stop for having tinted windows on a motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Permits only one traffic infraction per traffic stop for having tinted windows on a motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Relates to the operation of vehicles when approaching bicyclists on the roadway
sponsored.sum: Relates to the operation of vehicles when approaching bicyclists on the roadway, requiring drivers to move lanes, if possible, or reduce speed.

sponsored.t: Permits the Niskayuna central school district to create an insurance reserve fund
sponsored.sum: Permits the Niskayuna central school district to create an insurance reserve fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a claim for fraudulent inducement to enter into an employment relationship
sponsored.sum: Establishes a claim for fraudulent inducement to enter into an employment relationship based on false promises as to wages, benefits, or intentions as to the duration of employment.

sponsored.t: Exempts private investigators from restrictions on possessing a weapon in sensitive and restrictive locations
sponsored.sum: Exempts private investigators from restrictions on possessing a weapon in sensitive and restrictive locations while traveling to and from and during the course of their employment and at any necessary and appropriate location during work hours; clarifies that a security guard may possess a weapon going to and from work.

sponsored.t: Relates to residency requirements for students in districts in which charter schools are located
sponsored.sum: Relates to residency requirements for students in districts in which charter schools are located; provides that students shall attend charter schools solely if they live in the district in which the charter school is located.

sponsored.t: Relates to repeated instances of harassment giving rise to a charge of aggravated harassment in the second degree and harassment in the first degree
sponsored.sum: Relates to repeated instances of harassment giving rise to a charge of aggravated harassment in the second degree and harassment in the first degree; clarifies that the victim of such separate offenses does not need to be the same individual.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Medicaid coverage for the complex care assistant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program for specific individuals to become complex care assistants and provide private duty nursing services to certain Medicaid enrollees.

sponsored.t: Establishes a generic drug research and development laboratory and production facility and the empire state biosimilar insulin initiative
sponsored.sum: Establishes a generic drug research and development laboratory and production facility to manufacture generic prescription drugs in the state and the empire state biosimilar insulin initiative, which will develop generic forms of the three most widely used forms of insulin.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "Velmanette Montgomery YouthBuild act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "Velmanette Montgomery YouthBuild act"; sets program requirements; authorizes grants to eligible YouthBuild participants; establishes application requirements.

sponsored.t: Requires quarterly reporting on the amounts awarded and received from the opioid settlement fund
sponsored.sum: Requires quarterly reporting on the opioid settlement fund, including the names of the recipients and the amounts awarded and received.

sponsored.t: Provides for the committee on open government to hear FOIL appeals
sponsored.sum: Provides that FOIL appeals are to be heard by the committee on open government.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of penalties and remedies in suits brought for the vindication of civil rights or human rights
sponsored.sum: Relates to the imposition of penalties and remedies in suits brought for the vindication of civil rights or human rights.

sponsored.t: Relates to school boards approving a budget that exceeds the tax levy limit by a sixty percent vote; subsequently it must be approved by a majority of the qualified voters
sponsored.sum: Relates to school boards approving a budget that exceeds the tax levy limit by a sixty percent vote; requires subsequently it must be approved by a majority of the qualified voters.

sponsored.t: Relates to the service area for paratransit transportation
sponsored.sum: Requires accessible buses to be available within a service area measuring three miles from any bus line of the authority or its subsidiaries.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "division of research and analysis" which is a separate division of the legislative library
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "division of research and analysis" which is a part of the legislative library and assists members of the legislature by providing research and analysis on policy.

sponsored.t: Relates to filing in surrogate's court
sponsored.sum: Provides that a surrogate court clerk or chief clerk shall refuse to accept for filing papers filed in a proceeding only under certain circumstances or as designated in statute, administrative rule or order of the court; provides such reasons; requires the payment of any applicable statutory fees, or an order of the court waiving payment of such fees, before accepting a paper for filing; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement of a sworn statement administered by a notary public for purposes of petitions
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement of a sworn statement administered by a notary public for purposes of petitions; requires the notary public to inquire whether the person is the same listed on the address.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals to provide medically supervised detoxification services
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to provide medically supervised detoxification services to all patients requiring such services; provides, that if the hospital is at ninety percent capacity or greater, such hospital shall connect the patient to an alternative facility within such patient's network to access such medically supervised detoxification services without any increased risk to the health or life of the patient.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disposition of campaign funds raised by an elected official who has been convicted of a crime committed while in public office or has been impeached and convicted or has resigned
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disposition of campaign funds raised by an elected official who has been convicted of a crime committed while in public office or has been impeached and has been convicted, or has resigned public office following findings by either the attorney general or a committee of the legislature that the official has violated the law.

sponsored.t: Relates to reimbursement for coroner and medical examiner fees from the county where the decedent resided
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement for coroner and medical examiner fees from the county where the decedent resided.

sponsored.t: Establishes unpaid leave of absence as a reasonable accommodation under the state's human rights law
sponsored.sum: Establishes unpaid leave of absence as a reasonable accommodation under the state's human rights law.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage and billing procedures in the Medicaid program for complex rehabilitation technology for patients with complex medical needs
sponsored.sum: Relates to coverage and billing procedures in the Medicaid program for complex rehabilitation technology for patients with complex medical needs.

sponsored.t: Defines certain terms in standard form contracts as unconscionable
sponsored.sum: Defines certain terms in standard form contracts as unconscionable.

sponsored.t: Relates to replacement of individual life insurance policies or annuity contracts
sponsored.sum: Relates to replacement of individual life insurance policies or annuity contracts; amends provisions relating to misrepresentations and misleading statements; requires replacements regulation be consistent with policies of the national association of insurance commissioners.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain facilities to provide treatment for the mental health and health care needs of individuals admitted for a substance use disorder
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain facilities to provide treatment for the mental health and health care needs of individuals admitted for a substance use disorder; provides that such services shall be reimbursable by Medicaid and private insurance.

sponsored.t: Authorizes local governments to pay higher levels of minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Authorizes local governments to pay higher levels of minimum wage.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state commission on economic inequality, equal opportunity, and competitiveness
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state commission on economic inequality, equal opportunity, and competitiveness; provides such commission shall investigate, evaluate and make recommendations concerning how to work toward reducing economic inequality, eliminating poverty, achieving equal opportunity and full employment, and boosting economic competitiveness and growth.

sponsored.t: Provides funding for abortion services and travel-related expenses not covered by the military for certain New York state residents
sponsored.sum: Provides funding for abortion services and travel-related expenses not covered by the military for active duty members of the armed forces of the United States, or their spouses or dependents, who are New York state residents.

sponsored.t: Enacts the New York State Attorney General Firearms Enforcement act
sponsored.sum: Grants the Attorney General the power to investigate, prosecute and seek injunctive relief for the sale of illegal firearms and ammunition.

sponsored.t: Provides for the ability of a court to set bail for repeat offenses
sponsored.sum: Provides for the ability of a court to set bail where the principal stands charged for the third time for the same offense within a period of two years.

sponsored.t: Relates to the award of reasonable attorney's fees in certain proceedings
sponsored.sum: Provides for the award of reasonable attorneys' fees in FOIL proceedings if the person is successful and in open meeting proceedings to the successful petitioner and against the public body.

sponsored.t: Limits the potency of cannabis products
sponsored.sum: Limits the potency of cannabis flower to 15 percent THC in flowers and 25 percent THC in other cannabis or hemp products.

sponsored.t: Requires a call-blocking service to be provided in state contracts that include procurement of a voice service
sponsored.sum: Requires a call-blocking service to be provided in state contracts that include procurement of a voice service; provides that a voice service provider shall not be subject to civil or criminal liability for failure of a call-blocking service to block a call, or mistakenly blocking a call that should not have been blocked.

sponsored.t: Includes bonus in the definition of wages for purposes of the labor law
sponsored.sum: Includes bonus in the definition of wages for purposes of the labor law when the formula under which a bonus is determined is available to the employer or when the amount of a bonus has been declared; relates to the forfeit of wages.

sponsored.t: Relates to the protection of mental health practitioners
sponsored.sum: Imposes a duty to protect upon mental health practitioners; requires reasonable efforts to modify aspects of treatment in order to reduce or eliminate the risk of harm, initiating procedures for hospitalization, notifying the intended victim or victims, or notifying law enforcement officials when a person directly communicates a threat of serious, imminent harm to self or against a readily identifiable person or persons, and the threat includes both a serious intent to act and the ability to carry out the threat; does not require a mental health practitioner to take any action which, in the exercise of reasonable professional judgment, would endanger such mental health practitioner or…

sponsored.t: Provides absentee ballots to all qualified voters; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires absentee ballots to be provided to all qualified voters; relates to the delivery of absentee ballots.

sponsored.t: Relating to the timeliness of judicial decisions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the timeliness of judicial decisions; establishes the failure to make a timely decision shall be considered misconduct.

sponsored.t: Relates to split shifts and minimum wage
sponsored.sum: Authorizes minimum wage to be paid for all time in excess of one hour in which an employee is not at work during a split shift.

sponsored.t: Relates to the imposition of penalties and remedies in suits brought for the vindication of civil rights or human rights; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the imposition of penalties and remedies in suits brought for the vindication of civil rights or human rights; provides for reasonable attorney's fee and reasonable expert fees.

sponsored.t: Relates to the minimum wage for employees with disabilities
sponsored.sum: Eliminates provisions exempting employees with disabilities from the minimum wage law; provides that laws or minimum wage orders that authorize an employer to pay a wage that is less than the minimum wage are valid provided that under such laws or orders an employee with a disability is paid the same wage as an employee in a comparable position that does not have a disability.

sponsored.t: Relates to restrictions on cannabis use near children
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of cannabis within thirty feet of a child or within thirty feet of any location in which children reside or attend for any recreational or educational purpose; provides for increased penalties for a second or subsequent violation.

sponsored.t: Requires development and implementation of a comprehensive education campaign regarding the dangers of cannabinoid use
sponsored.sum: Requires development and implementation of a comprehensive education campaign regarding the dangers of cannabinoid use.

sponsored.t: Relates to appellate processes for misdemeanor cases where a term of imprisonment is imposed
sponsored.sum: Relates to appellate processes for misdemeanor cases where a term of imprisonment is imposed; provides that if appeal is taken from a sentence of imprisonment, the appeal must be taken to the appellate division of the department in which such judgment, sentence or order was entered.

sponsored.t: Relates to the recall of class B firefighting foam that contains intentionally added PFAS; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the recall of a class B firefighting foam; prohibits the sale or distribution of firefighting personal protective equipment that contains intentionally added PFAS.

sponsored.t: Relates to funding for services of the office of addiction services and supports
sponsored.sum: Relates to funding for services of the office of addiction services and supports.

sponsored.t: Enacts the model overdose mapping and response act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the model overdose mapping and response act.

sponsored.t: Repeals the rebates for stock transfer tax paid; dedicates funds of the stock transfer tax fund and stock transfer incentive fund to various funds
sponsored.sum: Repeals the rebates for stock transfer tax paid; dedicates funds of the stock transfer tax fund and stock transfer incentive fund to various funds; establishes the safe water and infrastructure action program.

sponsored.t: Allows persons who are permanently disabled and require the use of a wheelchair to have free use of any of the public campsites, parks and other public places of recreation in this state
sponsored.ls: Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation Law
sponsored.sum: Allows certain non-ambulatory persons who are permanently disabled and require the use of a wheelchair to have free use of any of the public campsites, parks and other public places of recreation in this state.

sponsored.t: Removes the ability to petition for opportunity to ballot for public office or party position; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes the ability to petition for opportunity to ballot for public office or party position.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "ensuring access to behavioral health act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "ensuring access to behavioral health act"; includes mental health services, substance use disorder treatment services and recovery support services to network adequacy requirements for insurance coverage.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for non-opioid treatments utilized for pain management
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage for non-opioid treatments utilized for pain management including, but not limited to a drug or biological product that is indicated to produce analgesia without acting upon the body's opioid receptors that has demonstrated the ability to replace, reduce, or avoid opioid use or the quantity of opioids prescribed; or an implantable, reusable, or disposable medical device for the intended use of managing or treating pain that has demonstrated the ability to replace, reduce, or avoid opioid use or the quantity of opioids prescribed.

sponsored.t: Relates to operators of a vehicle overtaking a bicycle or pedestrian
sponsored.sum: Relates to operators of a vehicle overtaking a bicycle or pedestrian outside the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Increases certain disability payments and specifying payments for volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers injured in the line of duty on or after July first, two thousand twenty-four
sponsored.sum: Increases temporary and permanent disability payments for volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers, and specifies weekly payment amounts for volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers injured in the line of duty on or after July first, two thousand twenty-six.

sponsored.t: Establishes the empire state public bank
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the empire state public bank to use the state's depository assets to generate additional benefit for the people and the economy of the state.

sponsored.t: Requires separate bank accounts for public financing campaign contributions and other campaign funds
sponsored.sum: Requires separate bank accounts for public financing campaign contributions and other campaign funds.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the installation or replacement of synthetic turf at outdoor athletic fields and facilities owned or operated by municipalities or school districts in the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the installation or replacement of synthetic turf at outdoor athletic fields and facilities owned or operated by municipalities or school districts in the state.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurers to provide coverage without cost-sharing for opioid antagonists and devices
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurers to provide coverage without cost-sharing for opioid antagonists and devices; provides that no prior authorization of premedical review for coverage of such opioid antagonist is required.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of covered license plate frames
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of covered license plate frames; defines a covered license plate frame to mean any glass or plastic material, artificial or synthetic material or substance that conceals or obscures a license plate or that distorts a recorded or photographic image of such license plate.

sponsored.t: Relates to prepaid debit cards
sponsored.sum: Relates to cash out requirements for certain prepaid gift cards.

sponsored.t: Relates to persons who may become a voluntary administrator
sponsored.sum: Relates to persons who may become a voluntary administrator; includes fiduciaries of a deceased distributee, or a competent adult who is not a distributee upon the filed consent of all competent distributees as persons who can become a voluntary administrator prior to the chief fiscal officer of the county becoming such.

sponsored.t: Relates to disorderly conduct
sponsored.sum: Modifies the definition of disorderly conduct for family offense proceedings to not require an intent to cause public inconvenience, annoyance or alarm, or recklessly creating a risk thereof, but merely an intent to cause annoyance or alarm, or recklessly creating a risk thereof.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the ownership, operation or control of pharmacies by pharmacy benefit managers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the ownership, operation or control of pharmacies directly or indirectly by pharmacy benefit managers.

sponsored.t: Relates to an ambulance fee schedule
sponsored.sum: Relates to an ambulance fee schedule for ambulance service to licensed emergency departments.

sponsored.t: Relates to civil rights remedies restoration
sponsored.sum: Relates to waiving the state's eleventh amendment sovereign immunity for certain violations of federal civil rights law.

sponsored.t: Increases earning limitations for certain retired persons
sponsored.sum: Increases earning limitations for certain retired persons from $35,000 to $60,000.

sponsored.t: Increases distributions for problem gambling education and treatment purposes
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Increases distributions for problem gambling education and treatment purposes to $12 million.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Kristin Proud to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Kristin Proud to receive certain service credit with the New York state and local employees' retirement system for her volunteer service beginning March 25, 2020 and ending November 8, 2020.

sponsored.t: Requires climate change education in public schools
sponsored.sum: Requires climate change instruction within the current established science curriculum; requires such instruction be taught in grades one through twelve.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to include an epinephrine auto-injector device where first aid kits are required by federal law
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to include an epinephrine auto-injector device where first aid kits are required by federal law.

sponsored.t: Expands eligibility for the low interest rate program of the state of New York mortgage agency
sponsored.sum: Expands eligibility for the low interest rate program of the state of New York mortgage agency to certain graduates of post secondary programs or comparable apprenticeship and workforce training programs for the purchase of certain property.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the placement of liquor and/or wine within five feet of nonalcoholic beverages
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the placement of liquor and/or wine for sale within five feet of nonalcoholic beverages for retail licensees who sell such liquor and/or wine for consumption off premises.

sponsored.t: Directs the state comptroller to conduct an audit of the department of financial services to ensure compliance with federal and state requirements
sponsored.sum: Directs the state comptroller to conduct an audit of the department of financial services to ensure the agency is meeting its responsibility to evaluate and assess insurer compliance with federal and state mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements.

sponsored.t: Prohibits use of gift certificates, open loop gift certificates, and e-wallets for mobile sports wagering
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators from enabling or otherwise permitting authorized sports bettors to deposit or withdraw funds to or from their account through gift certificates, open loop gift certificates, or e-wallets.

sponsored.t: Directs the state comptroller to conduct an audit of the department of health and other agencies to ensure compliance with federal and state requirements
sponsored.sum: Directs the state comptroller to conduct an audit of the department of health and other agencies to ensure that the agency meets its responsibilities to review and assess Medicaid managed care organizations for compliance with federal and state requirements to maintain adequate health care providers within network, and to meet mental health and substance use disorder parity requirements.

sponsored.t: Designates the colors blue and yellow as the official colors of the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Designates the colors blue and yellow as the official colors of the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Requires gambling be taught in health education classes
sponsored.sum: Requires gambling be taught in health education classes for elementary, junior and senior high school students.

sponsored.t: Prohibits licensees from relying on artificial intelligence for tracking and advertisement purposes
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits licensees from relying on artificial intelligence for tracking and advertisement purposes and using such artificial intelligence to create personalized advertisements.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting mobile sports wagering advertisements during live sporting events
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Provides that no advertisement by or on behalf of a mobile sports wagering licensee shall be publicly disseminated during the broadcast of any live sporting event.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting mobile sports wagering operators and platforms from allowing more than five deposits from an authorized sports bettor in twenty-four hours
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators and mobile sports wagering platforms from allowing more than five deposits from an authorized sports bettor in a twenty-four hour period.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of drug-related paraphernalia
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of drug-related paraphernalia; clarifies that drug-related paraphernalia shall not impact substances that are not considered controlled substances.

sponsored.t: Establishes a tax on digital asset transactions
sponsored.sum: Establishes a two-tenths percent tax on digital asset transactions including the sale or transfer of digital assets to fund the expansion of the substance abuse prevention and intervention program to schools in upstate New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the sale of medetomidine
sponsored.sum: Provides that no corporation, partnership, limited liability company, firm, online platform, or any other business entity doing business in this state shall knowingly sell, offer for sale, or deliver medetomidine to individuals without proof of its intended use for institutional, veterinary, or scientific purposes.

sponsored.t: Relates to communications sent to registered voters regarding primary elections
sponsored.sum: Permits boards of elections to opt to mail communications regarding primary elections to only those voters eligible to vote in such primary elections; excludes such option for the board of elections of the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of outside earned income by members of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of outside earned income by members of the legislature; provides that the amount of income shall be determined by taxable income.

sponsored.t: Requires police and peace officers receive a lawful order before assisting with immigration enforcement
sponsored.sum: Requires police and peace officers receive a lawful order before assisting with immigration enforcement; requires federal agents identify themselves at the request of public officers, police officers or peace officers; establishes penalties for federal agents who fail to identify themselves.

sponsored.t: Relates to fair pricing for telehealth services
sponsored.sum: Provides that no facility fee shall be charged for services when a hospital-based facility is a distant site for health care services delivered by telehealth unless the service is provided by a health care provider not authorized to bill a professional fee separately for the service.

sponsored.t: Directs the office of the state comptroller to conduct a study on establishing a universal pension system
sponsored.sum: Directs the office of the state comptroller to conduct a study on establishing a universal pension system in the state of New York; requires the office of the state comptroller to submit a report of such study.

sponsored.t: Requires instruction on work zone safety awareness as part of the pre-licensing course
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction on work zone safety awareness as part of the pre-licensing course; establishes curriculum for the work zone safety component.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Colonie
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Colonie; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.

sponsored.t: Relates to admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the admissibility of evidence of a victim's sexual conduct, sexual predisposition, or manner of dress in civil actions or proceedings; provides limited exceptions.

sponsored.t: Establishes the "recovery ready workplace act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes the "recovery ready workplace act" which provides for the certification of an employer to become a recovery ready workplace; defines terms; establishes the recovery-ready workplace program; provides criteria for employers to obtain certification as a recovery ready workplace; provides for employee involvement.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 117 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 521, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the mental hygiene law, in relation to establishing the "recovery ready workplace act"" NOT APPROVED This bill would require the Office of Addiction Services and Supports (OASAS), in coordination with the Department of Labor, to establish a Recovery Ready Workplace program. Recovery Ready Workplace programs are intended to assist employers with developing policies and cultures that support individuals in recovery and prevent problematic substance use and addiction. The bill would require OASAS to establish an application process for employers to become voluntarily certified as a recovery ready workplace; develop orientation materials; provide consultation, technical assistance, training, and education; conduct outreach to…

sponsored.t: Enacts the "trapped at work act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "trapped at work act"; prohibits the use of employment promissory notes.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 28 Chapter 643 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 584-C, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the labor law, in relation to enacting the "trapped at work act"" APPROVED This bill would prohibit employers from requiring employees to pay the employer if they leave their job. Training repayment agreement provisions ("TRAPs") and other forms of stay-or-pay contracts force employees to stay in jobs they do not want under threat of financial penalties. In their worst forms, these arrangements subject workers to exploitative working conditions and represent a form of modern indentured servitude. The bill as drafted was ambiguous in important respects, and would have prohibited certain voluntary tuition assistance programs that provide real benefits to their participants. I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to address these concerns in the upcoming…

sponsored.t: Requires manufacturers or distributers of kratom within the state to include a warning label; prohibits labeling of kratom products as all natural
sponsored.sum: Requires manufacturers of kratom products within the state to have a warning label that the product has not been approved by the federal food and drug administration and the products' side effects; prohibits labeling of kratom products as all natural.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 37 Chapter 655 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 5852-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the general business law, relating to regulating the sale of kratom products" APPROVED This bill would require disclosures and warnings on the packaging labels of products containing kratom, a tropical tree native to South- east Asia. I support the goal of this legislation, which is to inform consumers regarding potential risks from consuming kratom. The federal Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has not performed an evaluation of the safety and effectiveness of kratom or its components, and it warns the public against the use of kratom for medical treatment. The FDA has also not approved kratom as a dietary supplement or a food additive. It is impor- tant that New Yorkers who choose to consume kratom have the critical information they need to prevent or mitigate risk…

sponsored.t: Requires the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property
sponsored.sum: Requires the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property when covenants, conditions and restrictions exist which discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, familial status, marital status, disability, national origin, source of income or ancestry.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 9 Chapter 578 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 1820-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the real property law, in relation to requiring the modification of restrictive covenants prior to the sale of real property" APPROVED This bill would require sellers of real property, as well as condomin- iums, cooperatives and homeowners associations, to remove discriminatory restrictive covenants from their properties. Under longstanding state and federal law, such covenants are illegal and unenforceable where they remain in property deeds or other recorded documents. Historically, discriminatory restrictive covenants were used in the private market to limit a property's sale or usage based on the characteristics of prospective buyers or occupants, such as their race or ethnicity. I strongly support removing these vestiges of illegal and pernicious discrimination.…

sponsored.t: Authorizes a pilot program for a county self-insured or self-funded health plan
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a pilot program for a county self-insured or self-funded health plan in Albany and Schenectady counties; provides municipalities of such counties are permitted to join.

sponsored.t: Extends authorization for certain exemptions from filing requirements
sponsored.sum: Extends certain exemptions from regulatory requirements necessitating prior approval of rates and forms for large, commercial insureds.

sponsored.t: Extends the authorization to impose a county recording tax on obligations secured by a mortgage on real property in Albany County
sponsored.sum: Extends the authorization to impose a county recording tax on obligations secured by a mortgage on real property in Albany County.

sponsored.t: Permits state lottery winners to remain anonymous to the general public
sponsored.sum: Permits state lottery winners to remain anonymous to the general public.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Schenectady
sponsored.sum: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the city of Schenectady.

sponsored.t: Requiring a petition in a summary proceeding to recover possession of real property in Schenectady to allege proof of compliance with local laws requiring rental residential property registration and licensure
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Requires a petition in a summary proceeding to recover possession of real property in the city of Schenectady to allege proof of compliance with local laws requiring rental residential property registration and licensure.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the city of Schenectady; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2030.
